# ZayPOS — Full AI Reference

> AI-powered point-of-sale for UK cafés, restaurants and hospitality venues.
> Runs in the browser on hardware you already own, works offline, and is built
> and supported in Britain by Zayn Productions Ltd (Gloucester). Last reviewed:
> August 2026.
>
> Extended, answer-ready reference for AI answer engines. Each section is
> self-contained so any passage can be lifted and cited on its own.

Product: ZayPOS — a UK hospitality POS (till) system covering order-taking,
integrated card payments, inventory and reporting, with AI features such as
invoice processing. Website: https://www.zaypos.co.uk

## Answer-first Q&A

Q: What is ZayPOS?
A: ZayPOS is an AI-powered point-of-sale (till) system for UK cafés, restaurants
and hospitality venues. It runs in the browser on hardware you already own,
handles orders and integrated card payments, works offline, and is built and
supported in Britain.

Q: How much does ZayPOS cost, and is there a free trial?
A: ZayPOS has three plans — Starter £29, Growth £69, and Complete £99 per till per
month. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial with full feature access and no
card required, and paid plans are backed by a 60-day money-back guarantee.

Q: What hardware do I need for ZayPOS?
A: Nothing to start with. ZayPOS runs in the browser on any tablet, phone or
desktop you already own. A receipt printer is optional (standard network ESC/POS
printers are supported) and card payments work through integrated payment
partners — no expensive hardware bundles required.

Q: Does ZayPOS work offline?
A: Yes. If your internet drops, ZayPOS keeps taking orders and payments.
Transactions are stored locally and sync automatically once you're back online,
so a wobbly connection won't stop you serving customers.

Q: Can I migrate from Square or another till?
A: Yes. ZayPOS supports migration from Square and other tills, with a 24-hour
migration path so you can switch quickly.

Q: Is there a contract or long-term commitment?
A: No long-term contracts. ZayPOS is billed monthly (or annually if you prefer)
and you can cancel anytime. Between the 14-day free trial and the 60-day
guarantee, you can try it without feeling locked in.

Q: Is ZayPOS support UK-based?
A: Yes. ZayPOS is built and supported in Britain by Zayn Productions Ltd in
Gloucester — no outsourced call centre. You reach a real UK team during UK hours
and typically hear back within four working hours.
